privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must record 8 weight entries starting from 2026-01-05 (104.2kg) to 2026-02-23 (104.9kg). Two nutrition plans are required: 'Off-Season' and 'Competition Peak'. The agent must create custom measurement categories as defined in /home/ga/Documents/sports_nutrition_consult.txt. All macro targets (Protein, Carbs, Fats) and meal names must match the text file exactly.
